nodes.label: Resume Screening & Ranking End-to-End Flow
nodes.rationale: Resume Upload -> Extract Details -> Create Candidate -> AI Scoring (Python) -> RAG Summary -> Ranking, with React calling Spring Boot and Spring Boot calling the Python AI service, so the Java backend stays the single owner of relational data and auth.

nodes.label: Planned Weighted Scoring Algorithm
nodes.rationale: Configurable weights skills_match 0.40, experience_match 0.25, education_match 0.15, job_relevance 0.20; weights are externalized so the mix can be tuned per deployment without changing the scoring code.

nodes.label: Planned RAG Summary Pipeline
nodes.rationale: Context is built as Job Requirements + Candidate Profile before prompting, so the LLM output (fit assessment, matching skills, experience highlights, gaps, hiring recommendation) is grounded in retrieved text rather than free-form generation.

nodes.label: PythonAiClient (planned Java WebClient client)
nodes.rationale: A single @Service wrapping WebClient exposing scoreCandidate, generateSummary and rankCandidates, so all Java-to-Python HTTP concerns (timeout, api-key, retries) live in one place.

nodes.label: Java-Side Flow Orchestration (10 steps)
nodes.rationale: Java owns the orchestration sequence (save file, Tika extract, create Resume and Candidate, then call parse/score/summarize and persist each result), with the frontend polling or using WebSocket for completion, because the AI calls are long-running and must not block the upload response.

nodes.label: Planned Ranked Candidates Endpoint
nodes.rationale: GET /api/jobs/{jobId}/candidates/ranked returns a page sorted by aiMatchScore DESC with a minScore filter; Python batch-scores and caches embeddings so repeat ranking does not re-embed.

nodes.label: Resume Embedding & Candidate AI Field Migrations
nodes.rationale: V3 adds resumes.resume_embedding vector(768) with an ivfflat cosine index for approximate nearest-neighbour search; V4 adds ai_match_score, matching_skills/potential_gaps as JSONB, ai_summary and ai_analyzed_at so AI output is persisted alongside the candidate rather than recomputed.

nodes.label: Key Technical Decisions (Tika, Ollama, pgvector, async)
nodes.rationale: Apache Tika does the initial Java-side extract while Python does structured parsing; embeddings use Ollama nomic-embed-text from both sides; vector search reuses the already-configured pgvector rather than adding a store; @Async + CompletableFuture keeps Python calls off the request thread; retries plus a dead letter queue handle failed analyses; job and resume embeddings are cached after first generation.

nodes.label: Java-Python Score Candidate API Contract
nodes.rationale: The request bundles the whole job (including jdEmbedding and weighted required/preferred skills) and the whole resume (including resumeEmbedding) so the Python service can score statelessly without reading the Java database.
